name: TPS563201
description: Very cheap 17 V, 3 A synchronous buck in SOT-23-6 with D-CAP2 fast transient response, for 5 V/3.3 V rails from 12 V.
notes: 17 V max: not for 4S LiPo (16.8 V full) or anything above a 12 V rail.
Output limited to 7 V. D-CAP2 needs some output-capacitor ESR/ripple; follow the datasheet values.

en.note: Active high, must be pulled up to enable (internal ~1.5 MΩ pull-down, 1 µA). VENH 1.6 V, VENL 0.8 V. EN abs max 19 V = VIN abs max and EN rec. max 17 V = VIN rec. max, so EN may be tied to VIN. Typical app drives EN through a 10k series resistor (R3) from an external EN signal.

notes: D-CAP2 adaptive on-time control, internally compensated, no Cff needed (C4 position in Fig 7-1 is 'Not Installed'). Stable with ceramic / low-ESR output caps.

Use the L/COUT values in Table 7-2: LC double pole must sit below the internal high-frequency zero. Per-row L range (min/typ/max): 1.0-1.8 V: 1.5/2.2/4.7 µH; 2.5-3.3 V: 2.2/2.2/4.7 µH; 5-6.5 V: 3.3/3.3/4.7 µH. COUT (C8+C9) 20-68 µF for every row. lTable lUh is the TYP column.
Fixed RBOT = 10k (R2); VOUT = 0.768 x (1 + R1/R2) (eq. 2). Datasheet VOUT range 0.76-7 V (features).
Max recommended duty cycle 75%: minimum VIN = VOUT / 0.75 (sec 7.3). Minimum off time 220 ns typ (310 max). No minimum on-time is specified.
Current limit is valley-detect on the low-side FET; ilimA 4.2 A is the DC output current limit (3.3-5.1 A) measured at VOUT 1.05 V, L 1.5 µH, not a peak high-side limit.
Quasi-fixed 580 kHz in CCM; when VIN < 7 V and VFB is below reference, frequency may drop (min ~200 kHz) to extend on-time.
TPS563201 = Eco-mode pulse skipping at light load; TPS563208 is the FCCM variant (same pinout).
Input: ceramic >10 µF recommended (typical app 2 x 10 µF + optional 0.1 µF HF cap); voltage rating above max VIN.
Fig 7-1 labels the 1.05 V design with R1 = 3.09k, but Table 7-2 gives R1 = 3.74k for 1.05 V (3.09k gives 1.0 V). Internal 1 ms soft start; hiccup UVP at 65% (10 ms restart).
